steps.command:
echo "=== TREE ==="
find /workspace -type f | head -50
echo "=== LEGACY SCRIPT ==="
cat /workspace/climate_analyzer/analyze_climate.py
echo "=== CONFIG ==="
cat /workspace/climate_analyzer/config.ini
echo "=== CSV ==="
cat /workspace/climate_analyzer/sample_data/climate_data.csv

cat /workspace/climate_analyzer/requirements_old.txt
echo "=== PY ==="
python3 --version
python3 -c "import pandas, numpy; print('pandas', pandas.__version__); print('numpy', numpy.__version__)" 2>&1
python3 -c "import matplotlib; print('mpl', matplotlib.__version__)" 2>&1 | tail -1
python3 -c "import scipy; print('scipy', scipy.__version__)" 2>&1 | tail -1

sbx put test_hello.txt <<'EOF'
hello
EOF
echo "put exit: $?"
sbx run <<'EOF'
pwd
ls -la
EOF

rm -f /workspace/test_hello.txt
echo "=== SCRIPT ==="
cat /workspace/analyze_climate_modern.py
echo "=== REQUIREMENTS ==="
cat /workspace/requirements.txt
echo "=== RUN ==="
cd /workspace && python3 analyze_climate_modern.py; echo "exit: $?"
echo "=== COMPILE ==="
python3 -m py_compile /workspace/analyze_climate_modern.py && echo "compiles OK"

cd /tmp && python3 /workspace/analyze_climate_modern.py; echo "exit from /tmp: $?"
echo "=== config parse ==="
python3 - <<'PY'
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, "/workspace")
from analyze_climate_modern import read_config, DEFAULT_CONFIG
c = read_config(DEFAULT_CONFIG)
print("sections:", c.sections())
print("password:", c.get("database", "password"))
print("output_path:", c.get("analysis", "output_path"))
print("dpi:", c.get("plotting", "dpi"))
PY
echo "=== missing csv ==="
python3 /workspace/analyze_climate_modern.py --csv /tmp/nope.csv; echo "exit: $?"
echo "=== bad schema ==="
printf 'a,b\n1,2\n' > /tmp/bad.csv
python3 /workspace/analyze_climate_modern.py --csv /tmp/bad.csv; echo "exit: $?"
echo "=== py2-isms grep ==="
grep -nE '\bprint [^(]|xrange|\bexcept .*, *[a-z]+:|\bunicode\(|iteritems|np\.float\b|pd\.datetime\b|ConfigParser import' /workspace/analyze_climate_modern.py || echo "none found"
